title: Be a Vet
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Today, you are a vet! A vet is a doctor for animals.
You work at an animal hospital.
You wear scrubs. You have a stethoscope to hear hearts.
A puppy comes in for a checkup. You look at her ears, eyes, and teeth.
Next is a dog with a tummy ache. Why? He ate a whole sock!
The sock comes out. The dog wags his tail.
A parrot needs a shot. Before you even start, he yells, "Ouch!"
You work with vet techs who help hold the animals and give medicine.
The best part? You help animals feel better. And you pet lots of puppies!
The hardest part? Some animals are very sick, and their families are sad.
How do you become a vet? Go to college for about 4 years. Then go to vet school for 4 more years.
What can you do now? Help care for a pet. Read about animals. Visit an animal shelter with a grown-up.

o: He was afraid of the shot
